review.body:
<!-- rivetari-judge-review round=1 -->
### Rivetari judge · round 1 · 1 blocking

#### Blocking

**acceptance (A5): Reference for inhale and exhale depth is a local literal, not read from config.ts** `src/lib/analysis/open.ts:64`
A5 names 'the reference depth for inhale and exhale depth' among the Appendix numbers open.ts must read from src/lib/analysis/config.ts. The card's constraints also require importing Appendix constants from config.ts. Inhale depth (peak.level - MIDLINE_PCT) and exhale depth (MIDLINE_PCT - next.level) are measured against `const MIDLINE_PCT = 0`, which is defined in open.ts. Only the depth-index reference (referenceDepthPeakToTroughPctOfMax) comes from config, and the card says the depth index uses avg depth only.
- **Repro:** In src/lib/analysis/open.ts, line 64 defines `const MIDLINE_PCT = 0;` as a local literal. openBreaths uses it as the reference for inhaleDepthPct (`peak.level - MIDLINE_PCT`) and exhaleDepthPct (`MIDLINE_PCT - next.level`). No FIXED_CONSTANTS or OPEN_CONSTANTS key is read for this reference; the config.ts import provides only bandEdgeEpsilon, normalRateBpm, normalDepthBand, referenceDepthPeakToTroughPctOfMax, depthIndexCapPct, maxEventMarkersPerOpenSession, artifactLimitPctOfMax and transitionRefineWindowS.
- **Fix:** Read the inhale and exhale depth reference from config.ts. If no key exists, add a new FIXED_CONSTANTS key, which is allowed. Assert it in open-config.test.ts and use it in openBreaths.

#### Acceptance
- A1: met — openMetrics and analyzeOpen return {whole, segments, markersUsed, markersIgnored}. open.test.ts covers 0, 1, 2 and 3 markers, a peak on either side of a marker, and an empty segment.
- A2: met — Literal fixture with all six cases; every metric is checked within 0.05.
- A3: met — Segmented fixture with 12/12/20 breaths; whole-session values match the hand-derived figures (44 breaths, 300/44, 32/44).
- A4: unverified — Noise-free end-to-end and Tier B tests are present, with one shared seed stored as data. Whether Tier B passes depends on the test run.
- A5: unmet — Inhale and exhale depth reference is hard-coded (MIDLINE_PCT). The cap key, its test and the index re-export are present. Lint, typecheck and test are left to the deterministic checks.
- A6: met — insideBand and depthIndex use bandEdgeEpsilon. open-edges.test.ts covers every listed edge, including the non-representable periods.
- A7: met — refineTransitions uses transitionRefineWindowS, asserted by a test. open-refine.test.ts shows I:E 2.0±0.05 refined and <1.9 unrefined. transitions.ts is untouched.
- A8: met — A single dated PROVISIONAL entry with both readings, the quotes, the 1.81 vs 2.0 effect, and the paced/open divergence. No other PLAN.md changes.

<details><summary>2 suggestion(s), non-blocking</summary>

- An ignored extra marker can still make the whole analysis throw `src/lib/analysis/open.ts:158` — Validate only markersUsed, or count invalid extras in markersIgnored.
- Refinement can reorder a close peak and trough, so the breath is silently dropped `src/lib/analysis/open.ts:199` — Clamp each refine window so it cannot cross the neighbouring detected transition.

</details>

_claude-opus-5-5 · 2 call(s) · Claude reviews, humans merge._

suggestions.title: An ignored extra marker can still make the whole analysis throw
suggestions.detail: All markers are range-checked before slicing to the first 2. A third, legacy marker past the end of the recording therefore throws RangeError instead of being ignored and counted.
suggestions.repro: openMetrics(t, {durationS: 18, markersS: [4.5, 9, 19]}) throws, although 19 would be ignored.
suggestions.fix: Validate only markersUsed, or count invalid extras in markersIgnored.

suggestions.title: Refinement can reorder a close peak and trough, so the breath is silently dropped
suggestions.detail: The peak and trough windows (±5 samples at 20 Hz) can overlap when a peak and the next trough are under 0.5 s apart. After sorting by index, the trough can then precede the peak. openBreaths then skips that trough-peak-trough run without signalling it.
suggestions.repro: Detected peak at index p and trough at p+6, with raw minimum at p+1 and raw maximum at p+5: the refined order becomes trough, peak.
suggestions.fix: Clamp each refine window so it cannot cross the neighbouring detected transition.
